title: ServerBox theme package manifest
description:
manifest.toml at the root of a .fsbt archive. The installer refuses an unknown table, an unknown field, and a value out of range rather than replacing it with a default, so this schema is as strict as the installer: it is meant to name a mistake while you type instead of after an install. See https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/development/theme-authoring/

One rule cannot be written here: a color under icons.colors whose key has no entry under icons.images is refused, because a cross-table check is not something a JSON Schema expresses. Every table is optional; the required keys are the ones no default exists for.

With kind = "icons" the manifest is an icon pack (schema 4): icons only, chosen apart from the theme and drawn over whichever one is in use, so none of a theme's tables.

format.description: Archive manifest structure version. Only 1 exists.

kind.description: "icons" for an icon pack (schema 4): icons only, chosen apart from the theme. Absent for a theme.

id.description: Stable identifier. A theme repository names the file for a theme after this.

modes.description: Supported theme modes. One mode locks ThemeMode; both allow System, Light and Dark. Duplicates and unknown values are refused.

schema.description: Inclusive range of theme schema versions this package is readable at, not the theme's own version. min is what a reader has to understand: a package that uses a schema 2 feature and says min = 1 is refused, and so is one that uses a schema 3 component, field or [layout] and says a min below 3, or carries more than 48 icons and says a min below 4. See "Schema versions" in https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/development/theme-authoring/

mode.description: Initial brightness preference: 0 system, 1 light, 2 dark. A single supported mode overrides it.

seed.description: ARGB seed for roles the palettes do not set. Defaults to 0xFF880E4F.

systemColor.description: Use the system accent when the platform provides one. Defaults to false.

style.description: Built-in icon family, used for every key this package carries no image for.

images.description: Icon key to the file that carries it, inside icons/. The file name must be the key with dots replaced by underscores, and either extension; nothing else can be named. A PNG is at most 512x512 and 256 KiB, an SVG at most 256 KiB and is checked as a document. Both are tinted with one color, so a drawing should use currentColor.

colors.description: Per-icon color. A key must name an icon icons.images carries; a color for a key with no image is refused, since it would be a typo that shows up as nothing at all. Without an entry the icon follows the ambient icon color.

type.description: "gradient" is generated from the palette; "image" needs the file beside the manifest.

opacity.description: Image opacity. Does not affect the generated gradient. Defaults to 0.18.

blur.description: Image blur radius. Does not affect the generated gradient. Defaults to 0.

tile.description: Schema 3. Repeat the image as a pattern, each repeat this many logical pixels wide, from the top left. Omitted draws the image once, cover-fitted. Only valid when type is "image".

shapes.description: Corner radii in logical pixels. A component override takes precedence over these. Omitted values default to 12, 8 and 10.

splash.description: Drawn over the app's first frames, then faded out. It is read once, at launch: choosing another theme later does not play a splash again, and a package selected during a launch does not play its own. Omit the table for no splash.

logo.description: One fixed name at the archive root, not a path. A PNG or JPEG is at most 2048x2048 and 512 KiB, an SVG 512 KiB and the same document checks as an icon. Drawn at 96 logical pixels, centered, and tinted like an icon only when it is an SVG: a raster logo keeps its own colors.

duration.description: Milliseconds the splash stays up before fading out. Defaults to 600.

components.description: Component overrides. Every table and field is optional; a missing field keeps the app's style, and an explicit zero or false is retained. Unknown component names, fields, states and role names are refused. Colors accept an ARGB integer or a ColorScheme role name, resolved against the final palette.

density.description: Spacing of Material controls. Omitted keeps the platform's default.

variants.description: Schema 3. Several themes in one package, e.g. the Trans, Nonbinary and Rainbow variants of Pride. Each variant is the package's own tables with its table drawn over them (tables merge, anything else replaces), and is offered in the picker as a theme of its own. Files in variants/<key>/ replace the package's file of the same name for that variant.

name.description: What this variant is called, e.g. "Trans".

icons.description: The package's icon files are shared: a variant may set the style and colors, not images.

inset.description: [left, top, right, bottom], each 0-64 logical pixels.

color.description: An ARGB integer (0xAARRGGBB) or the name of a ColorScheme role.

rgba.description: ARGB integer. Palette values are integers rather than role names.

button.description: Primary buttons: Material elevated and filled buttons, and Btn.elevated. The state tables merge with these values; per property the priority is disabled > pressed > hovered > focused > selected > base. minHeight needs schema 3.

buttonState.description: One button state. Supports the same fields as components.button, without further nesting.

textButton.description: Schema 3. Text buttons and Btn.text. Same fields and state tables as button.

textButtonState.description: One textButton state. Supports the same fields as components.textButton, without further nesting.

outlinedButton.description: Schema 3. Outlined buttons. Same fields and state tables as button.

outlinedButtonState.description: One outlinedButton state. Supports the same fields as components.outlinedButton, without further nesting.

iconButton.description: Schema 3. Icon buttons. The fields and state tables of button, plus iconSize.

iconButtonState.description: One iconButton state. Supports the same fields as components.iconButton, without further nesting.

search.description: Schema 3. Search fields that draw their own pill: the settings search, the server switcher and the in-bar search. The field inside never takes the input component's border or fill.

navigation.description: Applies to the bottom NavigationBar and the desktop NavigationRail.

appBar.description: Schema 3. The top bar of each page.

segmented.description: Schema 3. Segmented buttons and the app's own segmented tabs.

sidebar.description: Schema 3. Rows of the side bar and the settings menu.

switch.description: Schema 3. The selected* fields apply while the switch is on.

progress.description: Schema 3. Linear and circular progress indicators; radius applies to linear ones.

badge.description: Schema 3. Count badges, including the navigation rail's.

brightnessGroup.description: Brightness-specific tables. Only supplied fields override their common values, and button states merge too.
